data.long_meaning: Ujjawal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujjwala' which means a 'victorious flame' or 'a flame that never goes out'. This name signifies strength, victory, and prosperity. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ujjawal usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious flame and live with faith, good character and purpose.
